scope_disclaimer: Computational sequence off-target screening evaluates sequence similarity across 7 RefSeq non-target transcriptomes and the B. sorokiniana ND90Pr transcriptome under explicit thresholds. Absence of exact or near-exact hits indicates no match detected in screened databases and does NOT establish biological safety or absence of off-target effects in untested tissues, genomes, or microbiome taxa.

thresholds.near_20_of_21: length == 21 and mismatch == 1 and gapopen == 0, OR length == 20 and mismatch == 0 and gapopen == 0
thresholds.near_19_of_21: length == 21 and mismatch == 2 and gapopen == 0, OR length == 19 and mismatch == 0 and gapopen == 0
thresholds.short_background_noise_nt: length 16..18 exact or length 19..21 with >=1 mismatch below 19/21 matching identities (tracked for audit only, NOT flagged as high-similarity off-target)

priority_categories_v2.High computational priority: passes_filters and composite_score_v2 >= 0.80 and off_target_safety_score_v2 >= 0.75 and conservation_pct >= 95.0 and pareto_rank_v2 <= 2
priority_categories_v2.Excluded: fails hard_filters_v2 (exact 21-mer match in non-target/paralog, QC failure, or conservation < 85%)
